seed: Object names may encode position or identity. Work out the naming rule from the data and derive renaming on move, birth and removal from it, so names are never looked up.

synth.notes:
Ring+beam move vertically by 6 (A1/A2), carrying on-beam blocks and pushing any block they hit; the move is cancelled if any block leaves the play rect (colour-4 bbox).
A4/A3 change beam width by 6 within [1, play right edge]; a hooked next/collected block drags the on-beam blocks, otherwise the extending beam pushes blocks in the columns it sweeps.
Tags collected/next/todo update on hook/release, and the HUD bar on row 53 fills every 3rd non-click action (hidden count, kept only while frames match).
Names are identity (ring, beam, block_<colour>), not position, so no renaming rule is needed; the program never reads names.
Open: bar phase is hidden state; the stateless fallback recovers it from the bar width only approximately.
